received.pendingHint: Full details have not arrived yet. The amount and addresses shown come from the blockchain.
received.unverifiedHint: The details delivered for this invoice do not match the hash the sender recorded on-chain, so they are not shown. Only the on-chain amount and addresses can be trusted.
received.mismatchHint: The sender's details for this invoice state a different {{field}} from the invoice recorded on-chain. Only the on-chain record is shown, and this invoice cannot be paid here.

sent.pendingHint: This invoice's details are not on this device. Only the chain's record of it is shown.
sent.unverifiedHint: The details stored on this device do not match the hash recorded on-chain for this invoice.
sent.mismatchHint: The details stored on this device state a different {{field}} from the invoice recorded on-chain. Only the on-chain record is shown, and the recipient cannot pay it from Chainvoice.

invoiceVerification.payBlocked: This invoice's details contradict its on-chain record, so it can't be paid here.
